title: Xiaomi’s wide foldable promises more power than Samsung’s
summary: Xiaomi released the 18 Fold, a short, wide foldable phone with superior specs compared to Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8. The device has a roughly 1.4:1 aspect ratio on both its 7.58-inch inner and 5.38-inch outer screens, making it both shorter and wider than Samsung's offering. The launch intensifies competition in the foldable market as Apple prepares to enter the segment.
content:
Xiaomi is the latest manufacturer to release a short, wide foldable phone, in the week Apple is expected to do the same. I got to try the 18 Fold behind closed doors at IFA last week, and while it looks and feels similar enough to Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8, superior specs make it feel like the phone I wish Samsung had made.
The 18 Fold is Xiaomi's first book-style foldable since 2024's Mix Fold 4, but the company has followed Huawei and Samsung in moving to a short, squat design. zh.title: 小米宽屏可折叠手机承诺比三星更强大的性能
zh.summary: 小米推出了18 Fold可折叠手机，这是一款短宽屏设备，规格优于三星Galaxy Z Fold 8。该设备在7.58英寸内屏和5.38英寸外屏上的宽高比约为1.4:1，使其既比三星产品更短也更宽。此次发布加剧了可折叠市场的竞争，因为苹果准备进入该市场。

title: Eric Wu’s newest company, out of stealth since May, is going after construction’s labor crunch
summary: Eric Wu's NavigateAI provides AI-powered real-time guidance to construction workers through smartphones and Meta's AI glasses to address the sector's labor shortage. The company, which emerged from stealth in May, has raised $25 million from investors including Khosla Ventures and Lennar. The tool aims to tackle a crisis where major projects like data centers require thousands of additional workers.
content: Eric Wu, who built and ran Opendoor before stepping away in 2022, has had his new company, NavigateAI, out of stealth since May — building AI copilots that give construction workers real-time, hands-free guidance through smartphones and Meta's AI glasses, backed by $25 million from Elad Gil, Khosla Ventures, and Lennar to tackle a labor shortage severe enough that data center projects alone now need 4,000 to 5,000 workers apiece.

zh.title: Eric Wu新创公司五月脱隐后，正对抗建筑业劳动力危机
zh.summary: Eric Wu的NavigateAI通过智能手机和Meta AI眼镜为建筑工人提供实时AI指导，以解决行业劳动力短缺问题。该公司于五月脱隐，已从包括Khosla Ventures和Lennar等投资者融资2500万美元。该工具旨在应对一场危机——数据中心等重大项目需要数千名额外工人。

title: First Xiaomi, then the world: why Arm might give phone gaming a huge graphics boost
summary: Xiaomi's new 18 Fold smartphone features Arm's Mali G2-Ultra NX graphics processor with an AI gaming accelerator, marking the first commercial deployment after five years of development. Following Nvidia's approach, the GPU promises PC-like gaming performance including higher resolution and advanced lighting without additional power consumption. The launch in China could establish a new standard for mobile gaming graphics capabilities.
content:
The Xiaomi 18 Fold and its Xring O3 chip.	

China is getting first crack at a British technology that might change how mobile games are made and played. Today, the Xiaomi 18 Fold launches in mainland China with an Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX graphics processor inside its custom Xring O3 chip. What's so special about that? After five years of development, Arm now has an AI gaming graphics accelerator inside its GPU.

zh.title: 先小米后天下：ARM如何给手机游戏带来巨大图形升级
zh.summary: 小米新推出的18 Fold智能手机配备Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX图形处理器和AI游戏加速器，这是经五年开发后的首次商业应用。按照英伟达的思路，该GPU可提供PC级游戏性能，包括更高分辨率和先进光照效果，无需增加功耗。该产品在中国的推出可能为移动游戏图形能力树立新标准。
